query: DELETE FROM subscription_windows WHERE reader_key=? AND root_id IN ( SELECT root.message_id FROM board_messages root WHERE root.root_id IS NULL AND root.topic_id=? AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM thread_subscriptions thread_override WHERE thread_override.reader_key=? AND thread_override.scope_kind='thread' AND thread_override.scope_id=root.message_id))
